buffers: source is the complete pending UTF-8 string; workspace is the complete delimiter UTF-8 string and is read-only; output is an initialized 12-word state/request/reply. No input copy, framing or aggregate length/spec-count cap.
words: operation (0 Begin, 1 Fold, 2 Resolve, 3 Close, 4 Finish)
native spec ordinal; active flag for Finish
directive (0 fold, 1 visible-stop, 2 open, 3 body-stop, 4 close, 5 EOF-visible, 6 EOF-tag)
operations: Begin resets the finite fold. Fold consumes one nonempty borrowed opener in original spec order and increments its ordinal. Resolve chooses Open or Visible-stop. Close uses one nonempty active closer. Finish selects visible or extracted EOF using active flag 0/1.
selection: Lowest first occurrence wins; equal positions prefer the longest opener; equal positions and lengths retain the earliest spec. Matching is literal, non-nested and byte-exact. Proper prefix suffixes end at UTF-8 character boundaries.
error_effects: Output capacity precedes all request/input reads. Invalid request/state and short output leave every byte unchanged. Only output[0..96] changes on success; both strings and output tail remain unchanged.
caller_preconditions: The two input slices are valid UTF-8 strings and remain unchanged across an opener fold. Output is disjoint from input slices. Their lengths and spec count retain the original Rust public domain.
public_owner: The original fields, Vec specs, pending String, ActiveTag content, per-public-call output and exact Clone/effect/drain order remain in Rust. HIA owns matching, tie order, suffix retention, open/close/stop and EOF decisions.
scope: Linux x86-64 GNU opt-in public generic library. Other product/platform/installed/performance/retirement qualification is separate.
